text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we work, bringing both excitement and uncertainty. One major impact is automation, where machines handle repetitive tasks like data entry or sorting emails, freeing up employees for more creative work. Beyond this, AI-powered productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help us manage time and improve efficiency. The most valuable skill, however, is human-AI collaboration—using AI to analyze data while humans make final decisions based on judgment and empathy. Of course, this means job changes are inevitable. Some positions will disappear, but new roles, like AI trainers or ethics officers, will emerge, requiring workers to adapt and learn continuously.
